scene_analysis.scene_overview: A bright blue sky with white clouds over a city street with tall buildings and pedestrians crossing the street. The sun is shining brightly, casting shadows on the ground. A yellow DHL van is parked along the curb, with a few people walking by. The street is lined with tall buildings, including a modern glass-fronted building with a large window display. The sidewalk is made of concrete and has a few trees planted along it. The street is busy with cars and pedestrians moving about.
scene_analysis.buildings: The buildings are mostly white and brown, with some having balconies and others having large windows. Some have signs or advertisements on them. There are also some trees and bushes along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.materials: The DHL van is yellow with a black stripe running along the bottom. It has a large logo on the side that says 'DHL' in bold red letters. The van is parked next to a streetlight.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few bicycles parked against the wall.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are a few trees and bushes along the sidewalk, as well as some potted plants.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs along the street, including a parking sign and a directional sign pointing to different parts of the city.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The street appears to be quiet, with only a few people walking around. There are some benches and trash cans along the sidewalk.
